description: This file defines types, constants, and functions for detecting and handling inline evaluation interpreters, including parsing command-line arguments to identify inline eval commands for various scripting languages.

methods.name: detectInterpreterInlineEvalArgv
methods.description: Analyzes command-line arguments to detect inline evaluation interpreters and returns details about the detected interpreter and flags.

methods.name: describeInterpreterInlineEval
methods.description: Provides a human-readable description of the inline eval interpreter hit.

methods.name: isInterpreterLikeAllowlistPattern
methods.description: Checks if a pattern matches known allowed interpreter names.
